grid.layout_notes: Official 2-3-3-3-3-2. Reel 6: only 2-high stacked Revolver/Character; inactive if half symbols land; no lows.

other.name: xNudge
other.how_it_works: Stacked Wild on middle 4 reels; nudges fully visible; +1 Wild mult per nudge; several add together.

other.name: Quickdraw / Revolver
other.how_it_works: Full Revolver on last reel fires 3–6 Cylinder features: Backstab/Shootout Wild, xSplit, Infectious xSplit, Justice Wild, Boothill Multiplier (×5–×999).

other.name: El Gordo Revenge Meter
other.how_it_works: Levels 1–5; starting xNudge mult 1–5. Bonus on reels 2–5: +1 spin, fill meter spot, +1 future-level mults; 4 Bonus → next level after spins play out.

other.name: xRIP
other.how_it_works: If total paytable win < base bet, no payout.

wilds.name: xNudge Wild
wilds.behavior: Middle 4 reels; nudge +1 mult; add together.

wilds.name: Reel Split Wild
wilds.behavior: From 2 Slaughter Scatters; splits reel symbols in half.

scatters.name: Slaughter Scatter
scatters.behavior: Middle 4 reels. 2 → Reel Split Wilds. 3 → 5 Slaughter Spins; 4 → 5 Slaughter with 2 meter spots + upgraded nudge mults 1/4/5/6/7. +Revolver → Massacre.

scatters.name: Revolver
scatters.behavior: Last reel only; full Revolver → Quickdraw (3–6 cylinders); during Slaughter upgrades remaining to Massacre +2 spins.

scatters.name: Bonus
scatters.behavior: Reels 2–5 during bonus; +1 spin, fill Revenge meter, +1 future level mults; 4 advance level.

multipliers.name: Character / Boothill / Killcount
multipliers.behavior: Last-reel Character random mult 5–99; Boothill ×5–×999; Killcount adds Fibonacci-like mults to future meter levels.

specials.name: El Gordo Revenge Meter
specials.behavior: Levels 1–5 with escalating starting nudge mult; Killcount / Revenge Level Up from Revolver in bonus.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways on 2-3-3-3-3-2 (324). xNudge on middle 4; 2 Slaughter → xSplit; full Revolver → Quickdraw. 3/4 Slaughter → 5 Slaughter Spins (4 fills 2 meter spots + upgraded nudge); +Revolver → Massacre (sticky Revolver). Boosters: xBet 1.2×, Super xBet 15×, xNudge 35×, xNudge+Revolver 3,000×. Cap 500,000×.

phases.name: Configure boosters
phases.what_happens: Optional xBet 1.2× (Slaughter reel 2), Super xBet 15× (2 Slaughter), xNudge 35× (2 Wilds), or xNudge+Revolver 3,000×.

phases.name: Spin + Quickdraw
phases.what_happens: Nudges; optional 2-scatter splits; full Revolver fires 3–6 cylinder features.

phases.name: Evaluate + xRIP
phases.what_happens: Pay ways; xRIP voids sub-stake totals.

base_game_loop.notes: CMS nolimitcity.com/games/tombstone-slaughter. Affiliate title includes El Gordo's Revenge.

modes.name: Slaughter Spins
modes.retrigger: Full Revolver upgrades remaining to Massacre and awards +2 spins. Bonus symbols +1 spin and fill meter.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Revenge Meter levels 1–5; last reel always full Character (random mult) or Revolver.
modes.progressive_state: Meter levels; Killcount/Revenge Level Up from Revolver cylinders.
modes.end_condition: Spins done / level progress / El Gordo Revenged 500,000×.

phases.name: Enter Slaughter
phases.what_happens: 5 spins; meter at L1 (or pre-filled if 4 scatters); last reel Character/Revolver.

modes.effects: 5 FS; Revenge Meter; Quickdraw cylinders; upgradeable to Massacre.

modes.name: Massacre Spins
modes.trigger: 3 Slaughter + 1 Revolver (or upgrade from Slaughter); 4+Revolver variant with meter fill.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Revolver sticky on last reel; all Slaughter features.

phases.name: Enter Massacre
phases.what_happens: 5 spins; sticky Revolver on reel 6; meter active.

modes.effects: 5 FS; sticky Revolver; full Slaughter + meter features.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Quickdraw skipped on main-game spin when Massacre bought via Nolimit Bonus.

features.name: xNudge
features.effects: Nudge fully; +1 Wild mult; add together.

feature_buy.notes: Named boosters priced on CMS; separate Nolimit Bonus Massacre buy exists (Quickdraw skip note) without price.

ante_bet.effects: xBet 1.2× guarantees Slaughter on reel 2. Super xBet 15× also available.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 2-3-3-3-3-2; Slaughter/Massacre 5 spins; Quickdraw; Revenge Meter L1-5; max 500,000×; boosters 1.2/15/35/3000×.
